contexts.text: No Angel of a higher Heaven may look down...
A certain Angel looking down, heard these things...
The Angels petitioned the Lord to be allowed to look down into the world; and they looked down...
(The Angels said) We have looked down into the earth at those celebrated for erudition...
The Lord, and, from Him, the Angels, when they look down into the earth...
On Spirits who looked down. SE 5786:2. SE 5830. SE 5831. SE 5839. SE 5875. SE 5889. SE 5929. SE 5967. SE 6081.
When the Angels who are in the Heavens look down to those who are in such lumen...
When the Angels... look down into the earth, they see not one whit of it, but only the Church with men.
